source.note: workspace/ is the tree exported at the commit before the collective fix. The frozen master log is the recorded run's own output, sanitized in place; no line was dropped and no metric value was altered. The launch script's user paths are sanitized and the referenced judge template is shipped; see below.

replacements.reason: The recorded launch command passed --judge-api-key in cleartext and the value appears in the log; redacted.

replacements.original: third-party completion endpoint used by the recorded run
replacements.reason: Third-party endpoint; not related to the defect.
Absolute home path; rewritten to the in-container workspace root so the log reads cleanly. Path shape is preserved.
Not needed to reproduce the run's configuration; omitted together with the other absolute paths.
The recorded image is private and cannot be pulled publicly, so task.toml pins a shared public image instead. The issue tier reads only frozen evidence and starts no training.

replacements.what: absolute user paths in the declared launch script
replacements.reason: Machine-specific usernames and storage paths; not part of the defect, and the issue tier does not execute the script.

remaining_scan_hits.detail: Submodule URLs and unrelated upstream scripts under workspace/. They describe the framework tree, not the recorded run.
SGLang health-check IP and worker node name in the master log. They identify the recorded cluster, not the defect; credentials and absolute user paths are sanitized.
Internal proxy hostname in upstream miles scripts/docs. It is framework content, not the recorded run; no metric or root cause depends on it.

remaining_scan_hits.verdict: upstream framework files, not this task's solution
remaining_scan_hits.detail: Upstream chat-template assets for Qwen/MiniMax/Kimi and a coder1 utility. They are not the fix for the collective in policy_loss_function.

omitted_from_workspace.reason: Each job directory is ~450 MB; the master log of the recorded arm is shipped and the other rounds are cited in the README and oracle.
Git submodules; present as empty directories in the export, matching the other tasks.
Per CONTRIBUTING: weights are never shipped.

added_for_evidence.source: The pairwise judge template referenced by the recorded launch command; copied verbatim from the sibling CHIMERA task package.
added_for_evidence.reason: task.toml and launch_command.txt reference this path; without it the recorded configuration is not self-contained. The judge is a distractor, not the root cause.
